project.name: EGM4000 / EduGameMaster 4000
project.tone: adult premium cyberpunk + steampunk + cyber-aquatic control-room

fireKirin.credentialPolicy: EGM4000 opens this externally and never asks for, proxies, captures, stores, or transmits Fire Kirin credentials.

egm4000.status: Android debug beta + consolidated Web/PWA v5
egm4000.role: Gameplay intelligence, authorized evidence logging, metrics, replay, coaching, community, privacy-safe surveys, normalized events, safe research.

fsa.status: separate product; exact telemetry integration contract remains separate
fsa.role: Owned virtual/non-cash fish shooter game that can emit exact telemetry to EGM4000.

founderConsole.status: separate owner/admin control-plane product; EGM4000 includes only verified local prototype owner gates for community/surveys
founderConsole.role: Owner/admin console for users, settings, safety, virtual credits, content, experiments, moderation, surveys, and telemetry.

completed.C002: First-run guided tutorial with persisted seen/completed state and safe workflow education.
completed.C004: Community forum/blog prototype with posts, comments, reactions, reports, owner moderation and audit records.
completed.C005: Privacy-preserving visitor surveys with consent/decline/erase, first-vs-returning classification, pseudonymous local token, targeting, frequency caps, response storage and owner-only local builder.

incomplete.C003: Production sole-owner authentication is not complete; local role checks are prototype-only.
incomplete.C006: Dedicated session-derived Tips Center is not complete; existing evidence-based coaching is a foundation only.
incomplete.C007: The full 100-feature owner Admin Panel is not complete.
incomplete.C008: A071-A095 monetization capabilities exist in the canonical model but are not all end-to-end implemented.
incomplete.C009: R001-R049 return-user features and adoption/retention instrumentation are not fully implemented.

verifiedAdmin100Foundations.note: These are verified foundations inherited from C004/C005 evidence. Other Admin 100 items remain partial/model-only until implemented and tested.

android.status: Native Android debug/beta project preserved; current consolidation work did not replace Android source.
knownGaps: Needs instrumentation tests on actual devices.

webPwa.status: Consolidated local-first PWA with Fire Kirin external launch, capture permission, evidence logger, metrics/replay/coaching, C002 tutorial, C004 community, C005 surveys, checklist/ledger, export/import, manifest and service worker.
knownGaps: Needs production backend/auth for shared accounts, owner privileges, moderation and surveys.
Needs HTTPS deployment for browser capture.
Needs complete Admin 100 and R001-R049 implementation.
Needs visual/device QA and shared schema validator.

sharedSchema.status: Normalized gameplay event schema present; validators and fixtures remain a next milestone.

nextMilestones.title: Production sole-owner authentication boundary

nextMilestones.title: Continue Admin 100

nextMilestones.title: Implement A071-A095 monetization
nextMilestones.definitionOfDone: Exactly 25 monetization capabilities are implemented inside Admin 100 with safe, non-deceptive controls and measurement.

nextMilestones.title: Implement R001-R049 + adoption analytics
nextMilestones.definitionOfDone: 49 return-user features exist and actual adoption/retention is instrumented without claiming guaranteed use.

nextMilestones.title: Shared schema validator and fixtures
nextMilestones.definitionOfDone: Android and Web/PWA both produce/import normalized events that pass a shared JSON fixture validator.

nextMilestones.title: Android Evidence Review v0.2
nextMilestones.definitionOfDone: Export/import, filters, risk flags, replay summary, and safety copy are implemented and tested.
